keyFindings.description: :2546-2551 finds an ask block's opener by `ask{#${id} ` / `ask{#${id}}`. Go now writes an id holding whitespace, a quote, #, ., }, &, etc. as `id="…"`, so dispatch request-approval reports the block 'which version N does not hold yet' and refuses on every try. Before round 7 the raw `#a b` spelling matched. Port TypedBlockIDAttribute to TypeScript (in @legion/contracts, with a shared Go/TS spelling table), build the needles from it, add test cases for `a b` and `R&D`, and rebuild packages/claude-envoy/dist, whose three bundles carry the same line.

The reader (:278) and the writer (:391) each concatenate typedBlockIDShortcutStops+"&". Round-tripping depends on the two staying equal. Use one named constant for the characters a written #id cannot hold.
:1721 says 'no whitespace' ends the shortcut; only space, tab and line endings do (U+00A0 stays in the # form, as the test table shows).
